!!! note "Simulator"
    Scored on flight_simulator 0.1.52, the simulator these runs trained on. The windowed track uses 0.2.8x, on which the same seeds generate different scenarios, so the two tracks' numbers do not compare.

10-aircraft MXP trombone, the fixed 100-seed pool, deterministic. **Success** = tier 5: every aircraft landed within ±60 s of its AMAN target, no loss of separation. Clean-subset success = success among episodes without a loss of separation.
